title: “Do I Trust the AI?” Towards Trustworthy AI-Assisted Diagnosis: Understanding User Perception in LLM-Supported Clinical Reasoning
reasoning: The paper investigates the clinical reasoning capabilities of LLMs and how physicians perceive them. While it uses terms like 'trustworthy,' this is defined in the context of clinical reliability and diagnostic accuracy. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or abstract moral/ethical systems.
